summary: PERM-2 preserved throughout: the agent/worker never self-grants. Part A only changes the recovery STRING for an already-denied facade tool to a grantable request_access; the actual durable grant still requires a user-permanent host decision, and it persists the CANONICAL selection (FileRead/WebRead/Browser), never the raw SDK alias. Grantability is decided by the shared isGrantableAutonomousToolRecovery (both lanes). Third-party MCP (source-first), locked-preset, and fixed-image tools stay non-grantable. Part B/C add no authority; declaration at creation is not a grant. No new attack surface; no secrets or trust-boundary changes.
residual_risks: Write facade tools (FileWrite/FileEdit) are now one-tap grantable on a pause card; mitigated by the risk label, explicit human approval, and the durable-access policy still gating persistability.
